summary.text: Wick Thomas is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 19 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Republican Karen Spalding is also on the general election ballot.
Thomas is a librarian by profession.

paragraphs.text: Wick Thomas earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri-Kansas City and a graduate degree from Emporia State University in 2023.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Thomas said they grew up in the small town of Drexel, Missouri, and worked as a librarian for the Kansas City Public Library, as manager of teen programs for the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, and as a faculty librarian at MCC-Penn Valley before entering the legislature.
Thomas was assigned to the House Insurance and Emerging Issues committees for 2025-2026.

In the survey, Thomas listed education, safety and support for the district as key campaign messages, and said that in the first term the focus had been on protecting vulnerable Missourians and getting money out of politics.
